ConstitutionRepository's _next_version reads MAX + inserts in two statements (no row lock). Safe at single-operator scale; a concurrent-writer retry-on-UNIQUE-violation lands at Milestone F when workers exist.

Milestone D is synchronous (D016): the Telegram webhook handler calls the model inline. Telegram retries on timeout (~seconds), so a slow model call risks duplicate replies. Async/background execution is Milestone F. Acceptable for D's definition of done; noted so it isn't mistaken for a bug.
